NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 8 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 1 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 30, 10:35 PM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs is the top-projected running back on the Week 8 DraftKings main slate at 27.9 DraftKings points for $9,500, against Minnesota. Bijan Robinson (23.5, $8,500) and Kenneth Walker III (21.7, $8,800) are next.

Bhayshul Tuten returns the most per dollar among running backs projected for at least 9 points: 3.00 projected points per $1,000 at $5,900.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 30, 10:35 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 8

Jahmyr Gibbs, DET vs MIN ($9,500)

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 27.9 DraftKings points at $9,500, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 4.3 points clear of Bijan Robinson. The model gives him 22.8 carries and 5.6 targets. The salary works out to 2.93 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 24 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 27.8 points with a simulated floor of 15.7 and a ceiling of 44.6, and he holds 28% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3-point favorite at home against Minnesota, with an implied team total of 24.75 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Bijan Robinson, ATL at TB ($8,500)

Bijan Robinson projects 2nd at the position with 23.5 DraftKings points at $8,500, 2nd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 21.1 carries and 4.7 targets. The salary works out to 2.77 projected points per $1,000, 5th of 24 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 23.3 points with a simulated floor of 11.2 and a ceiling of 40.6, and he holds 19% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 2.5-point underdog on the road against Tampa Bay, with an implied team total of 21 in a game totaled at 44.5.

Kenneth Walker III, KC at DEN ($8,800)

Kenneth Walker III projects 3rd at the position with 21.7 DraftKings points at $8,800, 5th on the main slate overall. The model gives him 19.2 carries and 4.1 targets. The salary works out to 2.47 projected points per $1,000, 10th of 24 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Walker averaged 21.6 points with a simulated floor of 9.5 and a ceiling of 39.9, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 1.5-point favorite on the road against Denver, with an implied team total of 21 in a game totaled at 40.5.

Value: Bhayshul Tuten, JAX vs IND ($5,900)

Bhayshul Tuten projects for 17.7 DraftKings points at $5,900, which works out to 3.00 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 24 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 16.5 carries and 2.1 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Tuten averaged 17.5 points with a simulated floor of 7.3 and a ceiling of 32.7, and he holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Jacksonville is a 10-point favorite at home against Indianapolis, with an implied team total of 28.25 in a game totaled at 46.5.
